tests: A two-column flow containing one figure that spans both columns with a narrower caption beneath it, and a second figure confined to one column with its own caption.
attacks: Reading order and caption association simultaneously. The spanning figure interrupts the column flow, and its caption is narrower than the figure, so a horizontal-overlap threshold measured against the figure's width may reject the correct caption. Figure 2's caption sits in the same column and is closer to Figure 1 in raw vertical distance on the page than a column-unaware measure expects.
